description: Create a new disposable email address that can receive email right away. Use it to sign up for a website, receive a verification code or link, or test an email flow. Returns the address and an inbox_id for the other tools.

domain.description: Optional custom domain the user has verified in OpenInbox (e.g. "mail.example.com"). Useful when a site blocks shared temporary-email domains. Omit to use OpenInbox's domains.

prefix.description: Optional custom local part, e.g. "jane.test" → jane.test@<domain>. Needs a plan with custom aliases.

name: create_inbox
title: Create inbox
